planting.note: Plant divisions or potted stock in spring in rich, well-drained soil; stake tall spikes in windy sites.

directions: A new 2026 Proven Winners Perennials introduction from Walters Gardens, this mid-height hybrid delphinium produces upright flower spikes mixing deep violet, purple, and blue petals around a crisp white center bee. Its 30-36 inch stems suit the middle of a mixed border without the floppiness of older strains. It performs best in full sun to light afternoon shade in regions with cool summers, where delphiniums are most reliably perennial.
sources: Walters Gardens (waltersgardens.com) — New Proven Winners Perennials for 2026

common_name: Hearts on Fire Old-Fashioned Bleeding Heart

planting.note: Plant in humus-rich, moist soil in part shade; foliage color is best protected from hot afternoon sun.

directions: Introduced by Walters Gardens as part of their 2025-2026 new-items lineup, this old-fashioned bleeding heart selection pairs golden foliage brushed with bronze highlights against clusters of red, heart-shaped flowers that open in late spring. The arching habit reaches 18-24 inches tall and spreads wider than it is tall, making it a bright accent for woodland borders and shaded beds. Like other Dicentra spectabilis forms it typically goes dormant by midsummer heat, so pair it with later-emerging perennials to fill the gap.
sources: Walters Gardens (waltersgardens.com) — New Proven Winners Perennials for 2026

planting.note: Plant in average, well-drained soil in full sun; works well as a continuous low border along paths and beds.

directions: Part of Walters Gardens' new 2026 Proven Winners Perennials catalog, this tall fescue selection was bred specifically for crisp garden edging, with blue-green blades bordered by bright creamy-white margins. Clumps stay compact at 14-18 inches with flowering scapes rising to 18-24 inches, while the foliage spreads 30-34 inches wide, forming a dense, low-maintenance ribbon of color along bed lines. It thrives in full sun with minimal care once established.
sources: Walters Gardens (waltersgardens.com) — New Proven Winners Perennials for 2026

planting.note: Plant out after frost danger passes in sharply drained soil; in colder zones grow in containers that can be sheltered over winter.

directions: Among the new ART & SOL Mangave selections Walters Gardens is introducing for 2026, 'Aztec King' forms a broad rosette of silvery-green, arching leaves flecked with burgundy spotting and softly scalloped margins. Mature plants spread 38-42 inches wide while staying a modest 20-24 inches tall, giving it strong architectural presence in succulent beds or large containers. It needs full sun and sharp drainage, and like other Mangaves is reliably hardy only in zones 9-11.
sources: Walters Gardens (waltersgardens.com) — New Proven Winners Perennials for 2026

planting.note: Plant in lean to average, well-drained soil in full sun; ideal for narrow spaces where wider native grasses would sprawl.

directions: Featured in Walters Gardens' top new items for 2025-2026, this little bluestem selection holds vivid blue foliage color through most of the growing season before turning a deep cinnamon-brown in autumn. Its narrow, upright habit reaches 32-36 inches tall with a tight 24-26 inch spread, making it well suited to narrow planting strips and small gardens. Grow in full sun in lean to average soil; like other little bluestems it tolerates drought and poor soil once established.
sources: Walters Gardens (waltersgardens.com) — Top New Items for 2025-2026

planting.note: Plant in moist, humus-rich soil in part shade; suited to shaded rock gardens, woodland edges, or containers.

directions: One of three new Bouquet Perfect primroses Walters Gardens is releasing for 2026, 'Watercolour Blue' produces sky-blue flowers that deepen toward a richer blue at the centers, held in a tidy, rounded habit that resembles a ready-made bouquet. Plants stay compact at 5-8 inches tall and 10-12 inches wide, suiting shaded rock gardens, woodland edges, or spring container displays. Grow in full to part shade in consistently moist, humus-rich soil for the best bloom display.
